payload.summary: Teaching dual sign-off keeps assessments in server memory; decide durable storage or keep as a gated prototype
payload.detail: The trainee-supervisor sign-off repository (src/lib/teaching/assessments/dual-sign-off.ts) is an in-memory Map used only by src/app/api/teaching/assessments/dual-sign-off/route.ts, which already returns 503 when NODE_ENV is production, so nothing is lost today and no screen calls it. Owner decision needed: build a Supabase table with RLS and owner scoping before enabling it, or keep it a gated prototype. Do not remove the production refusal until a durable store exists. Next action: owner chooses; if building, plan the migration inside an approved window (merging a supabase/ change deploys to the live database).
payload.source: Review of five Antigravity reports against main, 2026-10-12
